text: Matsoni, from Georgia and Armenia, is soured mainly by thermophilic S. thermophilus and L. delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus, the same pair as yoghurt, with strains carried from batch to batch. Yeasts such as Kluyveromyces marxianus vary by region and milk type.
